items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: I was interested later on when I found out that his name was really Prostopnik. ... And I assume he was one of the uh one of the Yugoslavian people that there were around New Orleans.

ctx.x: But they had names at least up there and you said you were impressed by Fazola.

Yeah. I was interested later on when I found out that his name was really Prostopnik. Uh huh. And I assume he was one of the uh one of the Yugoslavian people that there were around New Orleans. Yes. Frank Federico was in that group. Uh Sam Butera usually played one or two numbers but or at least solos on a couple of numbers but then I don't imagine there's too many you can do on a bugle anyway.
Oh Sam Decamel. Yeah Sam Decamel. Butera's a tenor player.
